meta.title: Media Library Export Import demo
meta.description: Installs the latest release with a few sample images and opens Media → Export / Import.
meta.author: wpgenius

steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php'; require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php'; require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/media.php'; wp_set_current_user( 1 ); foreach ( array( 'wordpress-logo.png', 'w-logo-blue.png', 'wpspin_light-2x.gif' ) as $i => $name ) { $tmp = wp_tempnam( $name ); copy( ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/images/' . $name, $tmp ); $id = media_handle_sideload( array( 'name' => 'sample-' . $name, 'tmp_name' => $tmp ), 0, 'Sample image ' . ( $i + 1 ) ); if ( ! is_wp_error( $id ) ) { update_post_meta( $id, '_wp_attachment_image_alt', 'Sample alt text ' . ( $i + 1 ) ); } }
